map.呼吸频率评估工具。输入静息呼吸频率，判断是否正常或异常等级，提示异常请及时就医，: The Respiratory Rate Evaluator takes the resting respiratory rate, judges whether it is normal or grades the abnormality, and advises seeking care when abnormal. It is a reference for self-checking vital signs.
map.成人正常静息呼吸 12–20 次/分: Normal resting breathing in adults is 12-20 breaths per minute
map.生命体征：静息呼吸频率是重要预警指标: Vital signs: the resting respiratory rate is an important early warning metric
map.异常识别：过慢/过快提示病情: Abnormality detection: too slow or too fast indicates a condition
map.运动参考：按状态给运动上限: Exercise reference: an upper limit on exercise based on the state
map.：算法：状态 = 呼吸频率<12 或 >20 判 3 级(异常)、否则 1 级(: Algorithm: status = respiratory rate <12 or >20 gives level 3 (abnormal), otherwise level 1 (normal); deviation from normal = |RR−16|; the exercise upper limit is 40 breaths per minute when exercising and a reference of 20 when not. RR>0 is required.
map.：例1（RR 16）：状态正常(1 级)，偏离 0 次。例2（RR 24）：异常: Example 1 (RR 16): normal (level 1), 0 deviations. Example 2 (RR 24): abnormal (level 3), 8 deviations. Example 3 (RR 10, exercising): abnormal (level 3), exercise upper limit 40 breaths per minute.
map.医疗健康类结果为按公式得到的估算值，不能替代医生诊断与处方。给药剂量、补液速度、: Results in the medical and health category are estimates obtained from formulas and cannot replace a doctor's diagnosis or prescription. Dosage, infusion rate and anticoagulation or thrombolysis decisions must follow the drug label, clinical guidelines and the attending physician; chest pain, breathing difficulty or altered consciousness warrant immediate medical attention.
map.正常呼吸频率是多少？: What is a normal respiratory rate?
map.成人静息约 12–20 次/分；>20 为呼吸过快（如发热、心衰、焦虑），<12: Adults rest at about 12-20 breaths per minute; above 20 is tachypnoea (such as fever, heart failure or anxiety) and below 12 is bradypnoea (such as sedation or raised intracranial pressure); seek care if it stays abnormal.
map.偏离正常数有临床意义吗？: Is a deviation from the normal value clinically meaningful?
map.仅直观反映距正常中值 16 的程度；真正判断看绝对值与伴随症状（发绀、胸陷、嗜睡: It only shows intuitively how far the value has drifted from the normal median of 16. The real judgement looks at the absolute value and the accompanying symptoms (cyanosis, chest retractions, drowsiness), and this tool does not replace a doctor.
